name: io.github.Pantani/tdmcp
title: tdmcp — TouchDesigner MCP server
description: Build real visual systems in TouchDesigner from plain language with Claude, Cursor or Codex.

environmentVariables.name: TDMCP_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool exposure profile. Registry scanners default to the compact static directory surface; all eight package profiles remain selectable.

environmentVariables.name: TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: Keep client-authored Python escape-hatch tools hidden by default in registry scans; choose on only for a trusted local runtime.

environmentVariables.name: TDMCP_DYNAMIC_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Registry scans remain static by default. Set on only for a client that refreshes tools/list_changed notifications.

environmentVariables.name: TDMCP_TOOL_MAX_ACTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum active tools in an ordinary dynamic selection (1..512).

environmentVariables.name: TDMCP_TOOL_METADATA_BUDGET_KB
environmentVariables.description: Maximum serialized metadata in an ordinary dynamic selection, in KiB (1..4096).
